import itertools
from pysat.solvers import Glucose3
vertices = range(22)
edges = list(itertools.combinations(vertices, 2))
edge_to_var = {e: i for i, e in enumerate(edges)}
solver = Glucose3()
for clique in itertools.combinations(vertices, 5):
    clique_edges = list(itertools.combinations(clique, 2))
    var_indices = [edge_to_var[tuple(sorted(ce))] for ce in clique_edges]
    # At least one blue (var positive)
    solver.add_clause([v + 1 for v in var_indices])
    # At least one red (negated vars)
    solver.add_clause([-(v + 1) for v in var_indices])
print(solver.solve())
if solver.solve():
    model = solver.get_model()
    solution = [1 if x > 0 else 0 for x in model]
    print(solution[:10])  # print first 10 to check
